name: The Maelstrom
description: A chaotic storm of mana at the point where the five shards met.

description_citations.text: "Alara". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: As the shards merge into the Maelstrom, their mana fuses into new monstrosities.
timeline.quote: As the shards merged into the Maelstrom, their mana energies fused into new monstrosities.

citation.text: Fusion Elemental (Conflux, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Maelstrom sends a wave of raw mana across a battlefield, carrying off the fighting and the fallen alike.
timeline.quote: The Maelstrom sent a wave of raw mana through the battlefield, carrying off the fighting and fallen alike.

citation.text: Soulquake (Alara Reborn, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: During the collision of the shards entire ways of life vanish without a trace.
timeline.quote: During the collision of the shards, entire ways of life disappeared without a trace.

citation.text: Maelstrom Pulse (Alara Reborn, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Knights from Bant drive Yidris into the Maelstrom, which stabilizes his mutations.
timeline.quote: Knights from Bant drove Yidris into the Maelstrom, a volatile storm of raw mana at the plane's center.

citation.work: It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!
citation.text: "It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Bolas is stopped from destroying all of Alara by Ajani Goldmane.
timeline.quote: was ultimately stopped from destroying all of Alara by Ajani Goldmane

citation.text: "Alara", section "Conflux". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the invasion the Maelstrom awakens to fight on behalf of Alara.
timeline.quote: the Maelstrom itself awoke to fight on behalf of Alara

citation.text: "Bant", section "New Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
